name: Legend
summary: This advanced 6-stage RO Water Purifier features Silver Nano Self-Flushing Technology , RO + UV + Alkaline + Copper + Zinc purification , and a Manual TDS Controller to deliver safe, mineral-rich drinking water.
intro: Lexpure Legend is a 10-litre wall-mounted RO water purifier designed for reliable and hygienic drinking-water purification. It features 6-stage filtration, dual sediment protection, coconut carbon filtration, Silver Nano Technology, anti-scalant protection, and self-auto flushing for improved membrane life and consistent performance.
features: Anti-scalant technology for longer membrane life
